newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: RESEARCH ALERT- POSCO recommended "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- POSCO recommended "buy".

text.p: ABN Amro Hoare Govett Asia said on Tuesday it had upgraded its recommendation for Pohang Iron and Steel Co (POSCO) to "buy" from "hold" as the company would benefit from a recovery in world steel prices.
The Seoul branch said recent hikes in world steel prices marked the start of a cyclical turnaround in the steel sector.
It said an average 3.8 percent increase in domestic coil prices would boost POSCO's earnings by 12 percent.
Anthony Moon said he raised POSCO's net profit forecast to 923.7 billion won on sales of 9.34 trillion in fiscal 1997.
